visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair styled in a bun sits on a light gray couch in a sun-drenched room. She is wearing a beige sleeveless top and dark trousers. Two small, round marble-topped tables are positioned in front of her. A large black-framed arched window partition stands behind the couch. (2) The scene transitions to the bedroom area, showing a large white bed with matching pillows against a minimalist wall. An arched opening provides a glimpse back into the living space. The lighting is natural and bright. (3) An exterior shot reveals the "HOTEL ELIENA," a modern multi-story building with dark gray textures and a prominent arched entrance. The sky is overcast. (4) The lobby interior is spacious and features dark floors, gray modular seating, and a sleek reception desk illuminated with pink light. Staff and several guests with luggage are visible in the background. (5) A hand holds up two yellow discount coupons for Olive Young. The background shows the modern hotel room interior. (6) The bathroom is shown, featuring white marble walls and a clean white sink. A black spherical light fixture hangs near the mirror. (7) In a mirror selfie, the woman is accompanied by a man in a gray sweatshirt. She presses a glowing red touch-button on the mirror, which turns white and activates the integrated LED lighting. (8) A close-up displays the room's amenities, including a white kettle and a black coffee machine. A hand opens a small refrigerator nestled within dark cabinetry. (9) At a bowling alley, the woman throws a bowling ball down a wooden lane. The pins at the end are struck and scattered. (10) Back on the couch, the woman wears a dark brown blazer over her top, smiling and gesturing towards the camera as the sun sets, casting long shadows across the room.
